Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@lumenai.com>

Subject: Follow-up: procurement path & marketplace interest (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI

Hi Ethan / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call today — really enjoyed the conversation and the product context you shared. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can align on the procurement/commercial path: 

Recap from today:
- LumenAI wants to evaluate Redwood for inference across your internal apps and a potential customer-facing offering.
- Technical fit looks good based on the latency and batching discussion; you want a short pilot first (2-4 weeks).

Procurement & commercial questions we discussed (can you confirm?):
1) Marketplace interest: do you prefer purchasing through a cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace, Azure Marketplace) or direct (PO/invoice or credit card)?
2) Payment method: does procurement require a PO (Net 30/60) or will a corporate card/centralized charge work for the pilot?
3) Legal/compliance items: you mentioned SOC 2 and a standard vendor questionnaire — do you have any nonstandard terms we should expect for SOW/PO or Master Agreement redlines?
4) Timeline: what does your procurement timeline look like for a pilot (procurement sign-off + PO or marketplace listing)?

Next steps we propose:
- I can send a one-page SOW and a pricing estimate for the pilot (attached).
- If you prefer marketplace, I’ll loop in our marketplace onboarding lead to confirm listing/private-offer options and timing.
- If you need PO-based billing, we’ll work with our finance team on invoicing terms for the pilot.

Please reply with the preferred commercial path (marketplace vs PO/card) and an estimated procurement timeline. Happy to jump on a quick follow-up with Priya if that helps.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing_estimate.xlsx

From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@lumenai.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement path & marketplace interest (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

- Marketplace: Prefer AWS Marketplace if the options are comparable. We like the consolidated billing and procurement visibility. GCP/Azure are secondary.
- Payment method: Procurement will need a PO for anything beyond a proof-of-concept that’s invoiced (pilot could run on a card if needed, but we’d prefer PO/invoice for the pilot to align with procurement). Our standard is Net 30.
- Legal/compliance: SOC 2 Type II required; we’ll send over our security questionnaire. Expect standard redlines around data retention and indemnity — not unusual but procurement/legal will want to review.
- Timeline: Procurement lead (Priya) estimates 2-3 weeks for a pilot PO + internal approvals; marketplace private offer listing could add 3-4 weeks on top depending on AWS onboarding.

Can you send the SOW and a SKU-level pricing estimate? I’ll loop in Priya for procurement details.

Thanks,
Ethan Ross
Senior Product Manager | LumenAI
ethan.ross@lumenai.com
